title: Virtual Head Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.17959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality. GQA achieves strong quality but incurs high KV cache overhead; alternative approaches such as MLA and MFA can compress the cache, but MLA suffers from quality loss while MFA substantially increases training and prefill compute. tldr: 提出虚拟头注意力（VHA），仅通过Q Premix和Linear Postmix两个可折叠的轻量级线性操作，同时减小KV缓存、降低训练与预填充计算量并保持模型质量，破解了长上下文注意力设计的“不可能三角”。
